paid_ads.title: Cellular Performance Institute: Celebrity-style podcast set clip (stem cells)
paid_ads.what: A Rogan-style podcast studio with headphones and mics; a guest talks about "mesenchymal stem cells… from a woman's umbilical cord". 47 s with captions.
paid_ads.how: A podcast set (2 mics, headphones, dark backdrop), the host asks one doubting question, and the guest answers with a mechanism. No direct sell.

paid_ads.title: BioRoot Labs: Podcast-plus-doctor stitched explainer (turmeric)
paid_ads.what: A woman on a podcast mic, turmeric close-ups, then a doctor with "Doctor-Formulated" and a "What do you think?" overlay. 129 s DCO with 32 media.
paid_ads.how: A podcast host intro, ingredient b-roll, an expert stitch, a CTA; build many DCO variants.

paid_ads.title: Pure Rhythm: "Content may go offline" podcast clip (weight loss)
paid_ads.what: "If you want to go from size L to size S, you need to hear this… three essential ingredients that the industry does everything to hide from you… share this with your friend because this content may go offline at any moment." 117 s.
paid_ads.how: A podcast guest, a secret framed as "what they hide", a share prompt. Use it carefully (it reads as hype).

paid_ads.title: Pure Rhythm: Menopause reframe podcast (hair / energy)
paid_ads.what: "When your period stops, your brain literally cuts off the signal to your ovaries… that's the moment you need to say, no, I'm not going to waste away at 50. I still have 30 years ahead." 101 s.
paid_ads.how: An empowering reframe of the life stage, then the mechanism, then the product.

paid_ads.title: Pure Rhythm: Tough-love podcast rant ("women over 40 who still don't know this")
paid_ads.what: "I can't believe… woman over 40 who still doesn't know this… waking up wrecked, bloated, drained… I'm not angry. I'm just tired of watching people suffer because no one tells them the truth. Magnesium is the foundation…" 84 s.
paid_ads.how: An older male expert on a podcast set, a frustrated tone, a 6-symptom list, one ingredient as the foundation.

paid_ads.title: Dr. Lisa Downing: "Men's health researcher" podcast (prostate DHT)
paid_ads.what: "As a men's health researcher, I study why the prostate swells… This is what most men over 40 get wrong about nighttime urination… Block DHT at the source… 3,000 mg cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil with saw palmetto." 54 s. Dr. Lisa Downing page, 1,357 ads.
paid_ads.how: A persona expert title (not "MD"), "what most [avatar] get wrong", the mechanism, the dose, the result.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Clips that start at the beginning of a thought are boring; start mid-sentence.
Avoid: A fake podcast with fake "experts" is deceptive; use a real person or label AI and avoid credentials.
Avoid: Burn in captions; 80% watch muted.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
